additionalRemarks._instruction: Enter any additional remarks concerning this raster image stack.

capturedWith._instruction: Add the device used to capture this raster image stack.

coordinateFramework._instruction: Add the coordinate space in which this raster image stack exists.

dataLocation._instruction: Add the location of the file or file bundle in which the raster image stack is stored.

dimension._instruction: Enter the common dimension of the consecutive image planes (optical sections) in pixels.

name._instruction: Enter a descriptive name of this raster image stack preferably matching the filename.

numberOfImages._instruction: Enter the total number of consecutive image planes (optical sections) in this stack (at least two).

pixelSize._instruction: Enter the common physical pixel size for the consecutive image planes (optical sections) (in x,y order).

z-stepSize._instruction: Enter the physical axial distance between consecutive image planes (optical sections) within this raster image stack.
